Insurance support

Start an inquiry. Then use the secure next step.

The first step is an email inquiry, not instant benefits verification. M.F.T. currently works with Premera, Aetna, Regence, and Cigna. Network participation and benefits can vary by clinician, service, and individual plan, so verification is required before relying on coverage.

In-network plans

Premera · Aetna · Regence · Cigna

Participation can vary by clinician and plan.

Out-of-network

Ask our support team whether a superbill is available for your service and what information your plan may require for reimbursement.

Couples services

Couples consultations and couples sessions are private pay. Do not assume an individual psychotherapy benefit applies to couples work.

How the benefits inquiry works

  1. Start with an email. Email support@mft.care to begin. The link opens your email app with a request for the next step; it does not verify your benefits.
  2. Provide needed information securely. Support will send the appropriate secure next step for any information required. Do not email insurance member numbers, dates of birth, diagnoses, or other sensitive clinical information.
  3. Confirm the expected cost before care. Review the intended clinician, service and individual plan with support. Benefits verification is not a guarantee of coverage or payment.
